description: NaSr₂CrF₈ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Na-F bond distances ranging from 2.26-2.54 Å. There are two inequivalent Sr sites. In the first Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to nine F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.43-2.82 Å. In the second Sr site, Sr is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight F atoms. There are a spread of Sr-F bond distances ranging from 2.48-2.76 Å. Cr is bonded in an octahedral geometry to six F atoms. There are a spread of Cr-F bond distances ranging from 1.93-1.99 Å. There are eight inequivalent F sites. In the first F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Sr and one Cr atom. In the second F site, F is bonded to two equivalent Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom to form distorted FNa₂SrCr tetrahedra that share corners with four equivalent FNaSr₃ tetrahedra and  an edgeedge with one FNa₂SrCr tetrahedra. In the third F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Sr and one Cr atom. In the fourth F site, F is bonded to one Na and three Sr atoms to form distorted corner-sharing FNaSr₃ tetrahedra. In the fifth F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to three Sr and one Cr atom. In the sixth F site, F is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Sr, and one Cr atom. In the seventh F site, F is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one Na, two Sr, and one Cr atom. In the eighth F site, F is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to one Na and three Sr atoms.
